Interface ClientView

All Known Implementing Classes:
GUIView, TuiView
public interface ClientView
Client-side output contract.

The networking layer (the VirtualServer implementations) does not know whether the user is using the text interface or the graphical interface. It only receives server-to-client payloads and forwards them to a ClientView. Each implementation then decides how those payloads must be shown to the user.

In the current client architecture this interface is used by MessageRouter: the router reads the payload type and calls the method that matches that type. TuiView prints the payloads as text, while GUIView can render the same information graphically.
